Thanks for the clear ask. Quick read and recommendations from capacity planning:

- Pipeline tie: DL-48321 looks like a 24–36 month onramp; for Q3 we should plan an initial tranche sized to cover first 3 months of committed throughput (estimate: 120 GPUs).
- Risk split: I agree to a hybrid approach — 60% physical (72 GPUs) and 40% cloud reserve. Cloud backfill buys us breathing room for any shipping variance.
- Negotiation posture: push to reduce expedite fee and lower deposit to 10% with a contractual milestone-based payment (10% on PO, 10% on production start, remainder on ship). Titan's priority slot benefit is real; ask Finance if 10% phased deposit is acceptable.
- Timeline note: given their +/-6 week variance, staged shipments are safer. Propose: Ship batch A (50% of physical tranche) Sept 1–15, batch B Sept 16–30.

Attachments: Vendor_Terms_Draft.docx (editable terms we can use to start legal redlines).

Cloud backstop: I've reached out to our cloud partner for temporary reserved instances for Sep/Oct. If they can provide a 6–8 week reserve, we should mark that as our primary fallback rather than paying higher expedite fees.

I'll coordinate with Finance Monday to see what deposit structure they'll sign off on and update the PO/payment milestones.
